Optional styling extras for the final slide (not for sale, no price shown — pick up to 2):
How to use it: (1) Right-click each reference photo above → Save Image. (2) Open ChatGPT, attach all of the saved photos to one message, in the same order shown. (3) Copy the full carousel prompt and paste it into that same message. (4) Send — ChatGPT should generate all images in one response. If it only returns one image, reply "continue with the rest" and it should keep going.

Note on prices: Image models still sometimes render text imperfectly even when asked directly. If a price comes out blurry, misspelled, or missing, ask ChatGPT to regenerate just that image, and as a fallback add it as a text overlay afterward (CapCut, InShot, TikTok's text tool).
